correctness.rationale: The five-state zero-diagonal irreducible Jacobi matrix J with downward parameters d=(0,u,v,w,1), 0<u<v<w<1, has five real distinct orthogonality points and normalized polynomials R_i(1)=1. All product coefficients are exact entries R_i(J)_{j,k}; triangle/parity eliminate zeros, reversibility relates the remaining 125 signs to nine nontrivial symmetric triples. Direct exact SymPy expansion confirms the nine-class table, notably g(2,4;4)=A/(1-u) and g(4,4;4)=C/((1-u)(1-v)(1-w)), so A,C are necessary. For the only third prospective wall B, D=(1-u)(1-w)+uw>0 and DB=(1+w-u)C+w²A; thus A,C also force B nonnegative, and the other classes follow from parameter order. Exact independent symbolic rederivation of the elimination identities and selected coefficient entries passed; finite rational samples add no universal claim.
